$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-5 & -1 & 0 \\ 4 & -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}],\,J=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}],\,P=[\begin{aligned}-1 & a & ∗ \\ 2 & b & ∗ \\ 1 & c & ∗\end{aligned}]

Consider the matrices above. Given that $A=PJ{P}^{-1}$ is a Jordan canonical decomposition of $A,$ find the value of $2a+b.$
